sources.population: Shanghai Diabetes Study II, six Shanghai communities 2007-2008; 4886 adults over 20, 1828 men/3058 women; excludes 360 previously diagnosed diabetes cases, missing questionnaires, under-20, cancer, severe psychiatric disturbance, chronic kidney disease, pregnancy and glucocorticoid treatment. Age-stratified multistage recruitment. Independent cohort from MIND-China.
sources.measurement: Measured BMI kg/m^2; HbA1c percent by Tosoh HLC-73G7 HPLC, within two hours of blood collection; 10-hour fast and 75g OGTT. Reported medians/IQR unless explicitly mean/SD. No survey weights specified for tabulated summaries.

sources.population: MIND-China 2019, rural Yanlou Town, Shandong; 3547 adults age61-80 free of dementia/disability, recruited for intervention eligibility; excludes missing glucose testing and diabetes-history information; includes previously diagnosed and treated diabetes. Table1 diabetes defined by FPG>=7.0 mmol/L OR glucose-lowering treatment OR diagnosis record. Other missing continuous/categorical covariates mean/mode imputed. Independent cohort from Shanghai survey.
sources.measurement: Measured BMI kg/m^2; HbA1c percent by Huizhong MQ6000 HPLC in NGSP-certified laboratory within two days. Fasting plasma/serum glucose differ in tubes, analytical methods and timing; correlations are Spearman. Table1 arithmetic means and individual SD, unweighted as described.
